method: Instruction-level independent interpreter; native GX compilation/hardware NOT verified

tests.name: Startup disables remote and clears stale requests
Remote START rejected until physical remote enable and heartbeat
Web heartbeat loss faults 108 and drops enable; reset never restarts
STOP physical input overrides remote START in same scan
Withdrawing remote permission during remote run stops
W2 reject A: one web request lights Y15 once for ~0.5 s, request auto-clears
W2 reject B lights Y16 only
W2 two rejects in a row give two separate flashes
W2 lamp refused without remote enable, in SIM mode, or without hardware arm
W2 indicator lamps work on a training kit with safety inputs X16/X17 not wired
W2 web heartbeat loss turns a lit reject lamp off immediately
W3 power-up: stopped, Y6 on, Y5 off
W3 press X0: Y5 on and stays on after release (latched)
W3 press X1: Y6 on, Y5 off, stays stopped
W3 a 1-scan (10 ms) tap on X0 still starts
W3 X0 and X1 pressed together: STOP wins
W3 holding X0 does not restart after X1 (edge-only start)
W3 X0 ignored without the web link (no remote enable or no heartbeat)
W3 web link lost while running → stops by itself within 0.6 s
W3 web START/STOP requests drive the same latch and auto-clear
W3 SIM mode or not armed: both lamps off and X0 does nothing
W3 reject lamps Y15/Y16 still work while the kit is running
Program has exactly one OUT coil per Y output (no double coils)
